notes.title: DLC: Echoes from Episode 3
notes.notes: [p]We’ve released the downloadable content “Echoes from Episode 3” a recreation of stages from [i]The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 3[/i]![/p][p]Enjoy the challenging stages![/p]

notes.title: Update ver 1.0.7
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Delayed the boss's first action when playing on Lunatic difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the durability of Bolmotz’s Deka-Marten based on difficulty level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fine-tuned vertical forced camera scrolling in some stages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some boss characters were not monochrome after being cleared.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the game to make it clear when a second character becomes available after the first clear.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the description of "Jammer Search＋".[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where save data initialization was not working correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected incorrect button icon display for cancel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a typo in ruby text in the Record section.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed button prompts to keyboard keys when playing with a keyboard.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where keyboard settings were not applied correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed button duplication indicators becoming misaligned when scrolling in button settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the effects of Jammer Search＋ persisted after retrying.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing event scene images.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted text balloon slide timing in pre-battle conversations.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected Franzha's description from “Demon God” to the proper term.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some text still displaying in Japanese in the Chinese localization.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemy PLAYING LEVEL couldn't be obtained.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where falling during Franzha's Himmel Teten would disable controls for several seconds.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update ver 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Punishment could not be activated while jumping upward.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Warp could be used from the Call Menu even if it hadn't been obtained.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where dash-jumping on the long staircase in Dannebrog Castle would cause the player to fall through.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemy defeat achievements would not unlock.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Battle Arena clear times would overwrite regular play times.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Note: Records believed to be from Battle Arena will be removed from the online rankings within a few days.[/i][/p][p][i]Note: As a special measure, a hidden command has been added to reset clear times on the Records screen.[/i]
Hold the following keys for 6 seconds to delete each difficulty’s record:[/p][list][*][p]Hike: Press [b]H[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Action: Press [b]A[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Parkour: Press [b]P[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Lunatic: Press [b]L[/b]
(The displayed character's time will be deleted. Once deleted, it cannot be restored, so please be careful.)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4 is out now!
notes.notes: [p]The long-awaited brand-new installment is finally here—enjoy the first full sequel in 8 years![/p]

notes.title: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4 Demo ver1.0.4 has been released.
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the display would glitch if the game was paused during the warp to the boss area.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where retrying during the warp to the boss area would cause the game to start inside the boss room.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the XY coordinates display on the Stage Select screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed discrepancies between visuals and collision detection in certain stage areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed areas that were supposed to be hidden when moving the camera vertically, but were visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the revert effect would play even when defeated in the small state.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential misalignment in the respawn position after falling while small.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Jizu’s size would not match properly when returning from a fall in the small state.[/p][/*][*][p](Japanese only) Unified the tone and style of the Codec descriptions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4 Demo ver.1.0.3 Released
notes.notes: [p][b]The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4 Demo ver.1.0.3 Released[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where hearts dropped by grounded enemies would appear in strange locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the timing of Chilavert's Revenge Magic activation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Bine Bine projectiles did not despawn over time.[/p][/*][*][p]Ghosts can now be left behind after clearing a stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a hidden feature: holding L2 on the stage clear screen will display your equipped Codecs.[/p][/*][*][p]\[English Text] Fixed a line that incorrectly referred to Chilavert as “his.”[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Broadcast of Gameplay Footage
notes.notes: [p]We will be broadcasting a pre-recorded gameplay video until the end of Steam Next Fest.[/p][p]The approximately 30-minute video will play on a continuous loop.[/p]
